xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4383: Work agents blocked on an operator decision have no channel that reaches Needs-you (PAN-2609 sat 16h)

plan.title: Work agents blocked on an operator decision have no channel that reaches Needs-you (PAN-2609 sat 16h)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One user-visible channel whose five acceptance criteria each land on a different existing surface (CLI verb, enrichment/Needs-you, answer delivery, derived attention for the Command Deck, God View, parked resolver, role prompt, docs). The projected-surface lint counts every two-segment path (each doc file, roles/work.md, package.json) as its own subsystem; the real code touches four areas (src/lib, src/cli, src/dashboard, packages/contracts generated manifest). Each item is an independent vertical slice over one shared foundation module, and splitting into sibling issues would ship a verb with no surface or a surface with no writer.

narratives.Problem: A work agent that needs an operator decision has no channel that reaches the operator. PAN-2609's agent posted an issue comment and a failed `pan tell flywheel-orchestrator`; nothing reached Needs-you, God View showed '17h idle', and the parked resolver classed it idle-running. The enrichment only flags prose turn-ends for interactive roles, derived attention only reads blocked panes, and the work role prompt routes blocking questions to the flywheel.
narratives.Proposal: Add `pan ask <ISSUE> "<question>" --option ... [--context] [--withdraw]`, which appends operator.decision-* entries to the issue's pipeline journal (the durable fact). Every surface derives the open decision on read: agent enrichment synthesizes an askUserQuestion so the existing Needs-you panel, dialog, TTS and desktop notification work unchanged; the answer route delivers through deliverAgentMessage and appends operator.decision-answered on ok; delivered pan tell and dashboard messages also close it; derived attention returns needs-you (Command Deck); God View draws a needs-you orb on the shelf row; the parked resolver emits an operator-gate row instead of idle-running; roles/work.md points blocking questions at pan ask; PIPELINE-GATES and GOD-VIEW docs describe it. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4383.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to roles/plan.md, review.md, test.md or strike.md
- No change to sync-sources/hooks/ask-user-question-hook or its detector contract
- No extension of `pan answer`
- No new HTTP route, no new PendingInputKind, no new read-model or contract field
- No stored decision status outside the append-only pipeline journal
- No server push service (ntfy/web-push); push stays the existing browser notification and TTS
- No issue-comment mirroring of the question
- The stall sweeper gains no action capability

autoDecisions.summary: Channel = new `pan ask` verb writing operator.decision-* pipeline-journal entries, not a labelled issue comment
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names either; the journal is workspace-scoped, append-only, event-firing (pipeline.entry) and needs no forge round-trip or poll.

autoDecisions.summary: Reuse the askUserQuestion pending-input kind with toolUseId operator-decision:<questionId> instead of a new kind
autoDecisions.rationale: Gets the Needs-you row, the dialog (with free-form textarea), rising-edge TTS, activity entry and desktop notification with no frontend or contract changes.

autoDecisions.summary: A decision closes on answered, withdrawn, a later verification.started, or a newer request; no transcript user-text clearing
autoDecisions.rationale: One journal-only rule keeps Needs-you, the Command Deck and God View in agreement and survives agent restarts.

autoDecisions.summary: Any delivered operator message (pan tell, dashboard message/tell) to the asking agent closes its decision
autoDecisions.rationale: The flywheel answers with pan tell; treating an operator message to a blocked agent as the answer avoids a second answer verb. The agent re-asks if it was not an answer.

autoDecisions.summary: The journal decision is exempt from PAN-1834 specialist suppression and from the startedAt filter
autoDecisions.rationale: Suppression exists for stale transcript residue; a timestamped decision request is fresh evidence and a restarted agent still owes the answer.

autoDecisions.summary: God View needs-you orbs sit on the shelf row in SWEEP_FLARE_COLOR with label '⚑ <id> · needs you <age>'
autoDecisions.rationale: The shelf means paused work still in the pipeline, and GOD-VIEW.md already defines the flare as an orb only a human can release.

autoDecisions.summary: Only the blocking-question shape in roles/work.md moves to pan ask; other roles and the AUQ deny hook are unchanged
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue scopes the work role; a Claude agent's AskUserQuestion already reaches Needs-you through the (PAN-1520) deny marker, whose text is a tested contract.
Matches the AskUserQuestion option contract the reused dialog renders; free-form answers still go through the dialog textarea.

items.title: Add the operator-decision journal core module

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-4383.md WI-1. Extend PipelineJournalEntryType with operator.decision-requested/-answered/-withdrawn. Create src/lib/cloister/operator-decision.ts exporting OPERATOR_DECISION_TOOL_ID_PREFIX ('operator-decision:'), OperatorDecision, isOperatorDecisionToolId, deriveOpenOperatorDecision (oldest-first walk: requested opens/supersedes; answered or withdrawn with matching data.questionId closes; verification.started closes; malformed data ignored), readOpenOperatorDecision (try/catch -> null), requestOperatorDecision (questionId od-<8 chars of randomUUID>, source 'pan-ask'), answerOperatorDecision (answer truncated to 2000 chars, source = via), withdrawOperatorDecision, operatorDecisionAsPendingQuestion (structural {toolId, timestamp, questions[{question, header:'Decision', multiSelect:false, options[{label, description:''}]}]}), closeOpenDecisionOnOperatorMessage(agentId, message, via) (workspace from getAgentState(agentId)?.workspace; appends only when decision.agentId matches; returns boolean, never throws). Must NOT import src/lib/agent-enrichment.ts.

Add the pan ask CLI verb

expected_outputs: lint-slash-commands prints '✓ composer-command manifest matches the CLI registry'

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-4383.md WI-2. Register `ask <id> [question]` next to `answer` in src/cli/index.ts with repeatable --option (collect into string[]), --context, --withdraw, lazyAction to ./commands/ask.js askCommand. askCommand resolves the issue id via resolveBareNumericId + toUpperCase, the workspace via getIssueWorkspacePath (exit 1 'No workspace for <ISSUE>' when missing), the agent id from OVERDECK_AGENT_ID or agent-<issue lowercase>. Ask requires a non-empty question and 2-4 non-empty options; prints 'Superseding <old>' when a decision is open; prints the stop-and-wait confirmation. --withdraw exits 1 'No open decision for <ISSUE>' when none is open. Rebuild, run npm run generate:slash-commands and commit the regenerated manifest. src/cli/index.ts cap is 1379 lines (now 1282).

items.title: Given an existing workspace, when `pan ask PAN-X "q" --option a --option b` runs, then exactly one operator.decision-requested line with options [a, b] is appended to .overdeck/pipeline.jsonl

Given no open decision, when `pan ask PAN-X --withdraw` runs, then it exits 1; given an open decision, it appends operator.decision-withdrawn

narrative.Action:
See .pan/drafts/PAN-4383.md WI-4. Frontend agent-kind answer POST sends {answers, toolUseId}.
